prompts.text: # build-own-login: every headless build keeps its own Claude login Brett, Nov 5 2026 (voice): "Yeah, it should be like that already." (after two builds died with 'Not logged in' because he logged the VPS Claude out to add another account). ## Problem Every headless build (deploy/claude-headless.sh via axHub vps.build_start, the orchestrator / agent-swarm launchers, console Terminal headless tabs) runs `claude -p` against the one shared login under the root user's ~/.claude. Logging out, switching accounts or adding an account on the VPS kills or re-points every running build. ## Fix - At laun…
